message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (h5ad files) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The quality control step (`control_quality`) and integer check exist, but neither performs outlier detection on training samples, statistical anomaly detection, nor filtering of suspicious/poisoned inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads datasets via h5ad files and applies feature selection methods, but there is no loading of pretrained model weights or serialized models, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training; StratifiedKFold is used for splitting but provides no explicit label distribution validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splits are generated via StratifiedKFold, there is no signed/hashed evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement beyond the split itself, and no use of multiple independent metrics to cross-validate results against tampering.

No detected input sanitization: The only input check is a raw-count integer validation in `_load_single_data` and an assertion on dataset name, but there is no shape/range validation or schema enforcement on inference inputs before they are passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning or recording results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline performs single-cell RNA-seq clustering/classification, not LLM text generation, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
